articles.title: ‘That wasn’t my son’: Mother of Berlin Pride attacker confronts his turn to terror
articles.summary: In the wake of the devastating events of July 25, Abdul Ballout's mother tries to reconcile the son she knew with what authorities have established about his radicalization.

articles.title: Hochul shells out over $7M to cover legal bills for 1,400 migrant children in NY
articles.summary: New York will spend $7.25 million to provide legal representation for 1,400 unaccompanied migrant children facing deportation, Gov. Hochul says.

articles.title: Unless Britain starts sending every Channel migrant abroad to be processed, the boats will NEVER stop coming: ALEXANDER DOWNER
articles.summary: Since Labour came to power two years ago, about 80,000 people have entered the UK on small boats crossing the Channel. On Monday, a dinghy arrived crammed with 230 migrants.
